# Shyam Enterprises - Safety Nets & Invisible Grills Bangalore

## Business Overview
Shyam Enterprises is a leading provider of heavy-duty safety netting, modern invisible steel grills, anti-bird spikes, and space-saving ceiling cloth hangers located in Bangalore, Karnataka. We specialize in household, commercial, and high-rise fall protection solutions.

## Technical Quality Specs
- **Nets**: HDPE Copolymer nylon, UV-treated, high-tensile weather-resistant.
- **Grills**: SS316 marine-grade stainless steel cables wrapped in clear nylon protective casing. Spacings: 2 to 4 inches.
- **Spikes**: Stainless steel 304 / Polycarbonate rigid anti-bird spike strips.
- **Hangers**: Rust-free stainless steel rods with smooth pulley-cord lifting systems.
